sloka: मातलेस्तु महावेगाः शरीरे पतिताः शराः ।न सूक्ष्ममपि सम्मोहं व्यथां वा प्रददुर्युधि ।। ६.११०.१२ ।।
transliteration: mātalestu mahāvegāḥ śarīre patitāḥ śarāḥ ।na sūkṣmamapi sammohaṁ vyathāṁ vā pradaduryudhi ।। 6.110.12 ।।

translations.english: Even though the arrows fell on Matali's body at great speed, he did not feel perturbed or experience even slight suffering.
